issue.title: Proposed tree removal for public park construction in Sumbal
issue.description: The Roads and Building Department Sumbal has invited tenders for cutting walnut and mulberry trees located on land where two public parks are under construction in Hilalabad Nesbal and Markundal. Local residents have raised concerns about the proposed removal, including a reported count of more than 70 walnut trees at Hilalabad Nesbal. Officials stated that the tree removal is being undertaken for construction of the public parks and described the step as being in the larger public interest.

reported_claims.claim: There are over 70 walnut trees at Hilalabad Nesbal.
Trees will be cut for construction of public parks.

action.title: Assess the proposed park sites for tree conservation alternatives
action.description: Assess existing vegetation and tree-cover data and identify whether park layouts or alternative site designs could reduce tree removal.
